title: MIS Officer (Re Announced)
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary
The MIS Officer will be responsible for managing MIS and data collection activities at the provincial level and will support the M&E team in reporting and analysis to track project activities. He/she is also required to develop web-based dynamic systems and create custom reports to address the project's needs. The MIS Officer will undertake a wide range of requirement gathering, analysis, and web-based database development tasks, including but not limited to those stipulated below:
Main duties and responsibilities:
Under the direct supervision of the WDIO Provincial Manager and technical supervision of the M&E Manager, the MIS officer will be primarily responsible for all Data entry and its quality/accuracy assurance related to the project. Additionally, MIS officers will be responsible for supporting provincial departments on software-related matters.
Support and participate in information exchange and coordination mechanisms with partners and relevant information systems/units.
Technical coordination and support of the MIS activities of the project and, overall, WDIO activities.
Advise and support technical experts on issues related to the use of MIS systems and digital data collection to meet the needs of the organization.
Preparation and dissemination of technical reports.
Designing and developing forms and data collection tools in ODK/Kobo/Enketo.
Building the capacity of social organizers and related staff members on the usage of related data collection and reporting tools.
Provide technical support and oversee the collection, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of WDIO, TLS project-related information from routine surveys, surveillance, and diverse contextual information sources.
The collection, compilation, and analysis of MIS reports related to the project and other WDIO-related activities in the province.
Strong follow-up with related departments for on-time data entry and sharing with the central office.
Data quality assurance checks on a routine basis, to check that the data is accurate and as per the project standards and norms.
Oversee testing and implementation of new or modified systems/databases
Provide training, write documentation and user manuals, including data standards, procedures
Ensure data security, storage, archiving, and backup recovery procedures are functioning correctly
Monitor performance and control access permissions and privileges
Analyze and resolve problems relating to the availability and security of the server-based databases as reported by users, ensuring that normal service is restored to staff as soon as possible after a failure.
Assess the project needs and design/ develop new dynamic databases
Establish policies and procedures for the management of data
Develop new web-based custom applications
Implement new software and solutions
Perform preliminary tests on new database projects
Train Staff on the Use of Databases and Custom Software
Develop software documentation and technical manuals for the newly developed systems
Designing and maintaining new dynamic databases and custom applications for the project.
Developing well-organized file management procedures and mechanisms.
Any other task assigned by the supervisor

Having at least a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Application, Software Engineering, or any other relevant field.
At least 3 years of working experience in designing databases.
Required Languages – Excellent Pashto and Dari reading, writing, and verbal skills, Fluent in English, reading, writing, and verbal skills.
Efficiency, result-oriented, and excellent management capabilities;
Capacity to perform effectively under pressure and harsh conditions; ability to handle confidential and politically sensitive issues responsibly and maturely;
Excellent capacity development and teamwork skills; cross-cultural and gender sensitivity;
Respect the confidentiality of the organization;
Ability to use information technology effectively.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word and Excel, Access a plus)
Ability to work under pressure and to meet deadlines
Self-motivated, pro-active, efficient, reliable, and creative
Strong interpersonal skills and experience with coordinating and managing other staff
Experience working in tough environments with many environmental challenges
Experience in report writing, Data management/analysis skills, excellent analytical ability

Uphold WDIO’s Safeguarding Policy ( https://www.wdio.org/safeguarding-policy ) and Safeguarding Code of Conduct.
Must read the Safeguarding Policy and either sign the Safeguarding Code of Conduct that is consistent with or references this policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct.
Must read PSEA and Anti-harassment policies and either sign them
Ensure that all the staff, partners and vendors selection process adequately implant PSEA, Anti-harassment Safeguarding Policies commitments.

description:
Job Summary
Position Summary
The Center Officer & Computer and English Trainer will be responsible for the overall day-to-day management and coordination of the Professional Development Center (PDC), while also delivering practical training in computer/digital skills and English language to participating teachers.
The position requires a motivated and organized individual who can manage center activities, coordinate with school authorities and project staff, maintain proper documentation, and provide high-quality computer and English training.

Job Requirements
Key Responsibilities
A. Center Management and Coordination
Manage and coordinate the day-to-day activities of the Professional Development Center.
Ensure that the center operates according to the approved project work plan and schedule.
Coordinate closely with school management and relevant education authorities.
Coordinate the activities of the pedagogy trainer and counselor.
Ensure that training sessions are organized and conducted according to the approved schedule.
Maintain accurate attendance sheets and participant records.
Maintain proper records of center activities, equipment, training materials, and other resources.
Ensure proper use and safeguarding of computers, internet facilities, furniture, and other center equipment.
Identify operational and logistical challenges and report them to the Project/Program Manager.
Support monitoring visits and provide necessary information and documentation.
Prepare regular activity updates and reports.
Participate in project meetings and coordination activities.
Maintain a safe, respectful, confidential, and inclusive learning environment.
B. Computer and Digital Skills Training
Develop and deliver practical computer training sessions for teachers.
Provide training on basic computer operation and digital literacy.
Train participants in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email, internet use, and other relevant digital tools .
Support teachers in using computers and digital resources for teaching and professional development.
Provide practical exercises and guidance based on participants’ skill levels.
Assess participants’ progress and provide appropriate support.
Assist participants in solving basic computer and software-related problems.
Encourage the practical application of digital skills in the school environment.
C. English Language Training
Plan and deliver basic to intermediate English language training sessions according to participants’ needs.
Develop simple and practical learning materials and exercises.
Support teachers in improving English vocabulary, grammar, reading, writing, listening, and communication skills.
Use participatory and learner-centered teaching methods.
Conduct practical activities to improve participants’ confidence in using English.
Monitor participants’ learning progress and provide constructive feedback.
D. Reporting and Documentation
Maintain daily/weekly records of training and center activities.
Prepare attendance and activity reports as required.
Document challenges, achievements, and lessons learned.
Provide information and supporting documents for project monitoring and reporting.
Maintain confidentiality of participant information and project documents.
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, English, or a related field .
At least 5 years of relevant professional experience , preferably with an NGO, education, training, or development organization.
Demonstrated experience in computer and digital skills training and Usage of Ai .
Good knowledge of MS Office, internet, email, and digital learning tools .
Good command of English , particularly in reading, writing, and communication.
Previous experience teaching or training adults, particularly teachers, is an advantage.
Strong organizational, coordination, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to prepare activity reports and maintain accurate records.
Fluency in Dari and/or Pashto .
Good English communication and writing skills.
Ability to work effectively with school authorities, teachers, project staff, and other stakeholders.
Commitment to confidentiality, safeguarding, PSEA, and professional conduct.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit:
Updated CV
Cover Letter
Application Email: hr.sdco@gmail.com
The Email Subject Line Should be: Application for Center Officer & Computer and English Trainer Vacancy (01-CO-SDCO)

Verify transaction status — completed, pending, failed, or reversed — before advising customers.
Handle first-line requests including PIN resets, account/KYC verification, statement clarification, incorrect-recipient transfers, and notification issues.

title: L2 Application Support Engineer - MoMo
description:

We are looking for an experienced L2 Application Support Engineer - MoMo with strong hands-on experience in databases, Linux, transaction troubleshooting, integrations, and production support

Duties and Responsibilities
Investigate escalated transactions across the full processing path — channel, access gateway, core platform, and downstream bank/aggregator.
Query platform databases to reconstruct transaction histories and produce operational reports and extracts.
Analyse application and system logs across servers and Kubernetes workloads, including events recorded across different time zones.

Administer service-provider portal accounts, roles, permissions, and reporting entitlements.
Produce incident reports, root-cause analyses (RCAs), runbooks, and known-issue documentation.

4+ years of application or production support experience with substantial hands-on database and Linux work.
Strong SQL skills, including multi-table joins, aggregation, indexed time-window queries, and awareness of query impact on high-volume databases.
Ability to trace individual transactions across multiple components and identify the failing point through log analysis.
Kubernetes operational knowledge — pods, deployments, logs, events, restart loops, and resource constraints.
Experience troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, HTTP status codes, APIs, certificates, and request/response flows.
Understanding of transaction reversal and reconciliation processes.
Ability to distinguish genuine ledger discrepancies from expected fees or timing differences.
Strong production discipline: read-only by default, controlled changes, prior approval, and rollback planning.
Strong documentation skills covering RCAs, runbooks, incident reports, and known issues.
Experience with mobile money or payment platforms such as Huawei, Comviva, Ericsson, Fundamo, or similar.
Python or shell scripting skills for reporting and bulk verification.
Experience producing SQL-based operational/business reports.
Exposure to USSD, SMPP, or SMS infrastructure.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered

description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Spring Boot Developer, you will be responsible for maintaining, enhancing, scaling, and supporting AsanPay EMI's existing wallet core system, payment processing platforms, transaction switching services, and financial integrations.
You will work within a mature microservices ecosystem that processes real-time financial transactions and integrates with banks, payment gateways, card management systems, and third-party financial institutions.
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, ISO8583, Microservices Architecture, Distributed Systems, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Enterprise Payment Systems.

Duties and Responsibilities
Payment Systems Development
• Design, develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise-grade backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
• Support and improve existing payment processing and wallet platforms.
• Implement and optimize transaction routing, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and ledger management processes.
• Ensure high performance, scalability, availability, and security of mission-critical financial systems.
• Participate in solution architecture, technical reviews, and strategic technology decisions.
• Analyze production issues and provide timely resolutions.
ISO8583 & Transaction Switching
• Maintain, support, and enhance transaction switching solutions based on ISO8583 standards.
• Develop and troubleshoot message parsing, packing, unpacking, validation, and routing mechanisms.
• Troubleshoot transaction failures through message-level analysis.
• Collaborate with acquiring banks, issuing banks, payment gateways, national switches, and financial institutions
• Monitor and improve transaction processing reliability and performance.
Microservices Architecture & Distributed Systems
• Maintain and enhance AsanPay's existing microservices ecosystem
• Develop new microservices to support business growth and regulatory requirements.
• Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions.
• Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
• Ensure fault tolerance, scalability, and maintainability throughout the platform.
• Participate in architectural planning and system optimization initiatives.
Event-Driven Architecture & Messaging
• Develop and maintain asynchronous processing solutions using Kafka and RabbitMQ.
• Design event-driven communication between microservices.
• Implement reliable message processing mechanisms.
• Optimize queue performance, throughput, and fault recovery.
• Configure:
o Retry Mechanisms
o Dead Letter Queues (DLQ)
o Event Replay Capabilities
o Message Auditing
• Ensure reliable event processing for financial transactions.
API Development & Financial Integrations
• Design, develop, and maintain secure RESTful APIs.
• Integrate with:
o Banks
o Payment Service Providers
o Mobile Wallet Platforms
o Card Management Systems
o Core Banking Systems
o AML & KYC Providers
o OTP Services
o Financial Institutions
o Third-Party FinTech Platforms
• Create and maintain API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
• Implement robust authentication, authorization, auditing, and monitoring controls.
• Support existing integrations and develop new financial connectivity solutions.
Database Design & Optimization
• Design and maintain financial transaction databases using PostgreSQL and MySQL.
• Optimize database performance for large-volume transaction processing.
• Design scalable schemas for payment and wallet systems.
• Develop efficient indexing and query optimization strategies.
• Implement:
o Replication
o Clustering
o Backup Strategies
o Disaster Recovery Solutions
• Ensure data integrity and consistency.
• Implement Redis caching to improve application performance.
Security & Compliance
• Implement secure coding practices across all applications.
• Develop authentication and authorization solutions using JWT and OAuth2
• Apply OWASP security recommendations.
• Ensure transaction integrity and auditability.
• Participate in security assessments and vulnerability remediation.
• Support compliance with financial regulations, security frameworks, and industry best practices.
Monitoring, Observability & Reliability
• Implement distributed tracing using Zipkin.
• Monitor application and infrastructure health.
• Configure centralized logging and log aggregation solutions.
• Implement proactive alerting and performance monitoring.
• Perform root cause analysis for production incidents.
• Ensure maximum uptime and operational stability of business-critical systems.

title: English and Computer Teacher (Balkh)
description:
Job Summary
Job Purpose
The English and Computer Teacher will provide structured, inclusive, and age-appropriate English language and basic computer education to students up to Grade 7. The teacher will also deliver basic English and computer classes to female Marastoon staff, as assigned, to strengthen their language, digital, and workplace communication skills.
Duties and Responsibilities
A. Teaching English to Students
Prepare and deliver English lessons for students from beginner level up to Grade 7.
Develop and use age-appropriate lesson plans, teaching materials, exercises, and classroom activities.
Teach basic grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, speaking, and conversation skills.
Adapt teaching methods according to students’ age, learning level, and individual needs.
Encourage student participation through group work, discussions, practical exercises, and interactive activities.
Conduct regular quizzes, assignments, and learning assessments.
Monitor student attendance, participation, progress, and learning outcomes.
Provide remedial support to students who require additional assistance.
B. Teaching Computer Skills to Students
Provide basic computer literacy and practical computer skills training to students up to Grade 7.
Teach computer components, basic operations, keyboard and mouse use, typing, file management, and safe computer use.
Introduce students to basic applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, according to their learning level.
Teach basic digital skills through practical demonstrations and supervised exercises.
Use available laptops, LCD screens, and other educational equipment effectively.
Maintain an orderly, safe, and supportive computer-learning environment.
Assess students’ practical computer skills and provide additional guidance where required.
C. Teaching English and Computer Skills to Female Marastoon Staff
Conduct basic English classes for female Marastoon staff, including vocabulary, conversation, reading, writing, and workplace terminology.
Deliver basic computer training covering computer operation, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email, file management, and other relevant digital tools.
Adapt lessons to the staff members’ existing knowledge, responsibilities, and learning needs.
Emphasize practical skills that can be applied in daily administrative and workplace tasks.
Provide exercises, demonstrations, and individual support to strengthen staff members’ confidence and competency.
D. Classroom Management and Student Support
Maintain a respectful, inclusive, child-friendly, and gender-sensitive learning environment.
Apply positive classroom-management techniques and promote discipline through constructive methods.
Ensure the appropriate use and care of classroom and computer equipment.
Identify learning difficulties and refer significant concerns to the Education and Training Officer.
Support the protection, dignity, and well-being of all learners in accordance with ARCS and relevant humanitarian principles.
E. Planning, Reporting, and Coordination
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly teaching plans in coordination with the Education and Training Department.
Maintain accurate attendance records, lesson records, assessment results, and student-progress reports.
Submit regular teaching and activity reports to the designated supervisor.
Participate in teacher meetings, training sessions, assessments, and curriculum-related activities.
Coordinate with other teachers to ensure consistency in lesson delivery and student support.
Provide feedback on curriculum materials, teaching tools, equipment, and identified learning needs.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree or recognized qualification in English, Education, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Relevant teaching experience, preferably with children or learners up to Grade 7.
Practical knowledge of English language teaching and basic computer education.
Experience in preparing lesson plans, conducting assessments, and maintaining student records.
Good communication, classroom-management, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work respectfully with children, women, and vulnerable populations.
Previous experience in educational, community-based, or humanitarian settings is an advantage.
Core Competencies
Teaching and facilitation skills
Communication and interpersonal skills
Classroom management
Planning and organization
Patience and adaptability
Teamwork and coordination
Respect for confidentiality and safeguarding principles
Commitment to inclusive and non-discriminatory education
Expected Outputs
Regular English and computer classes delivered to students up to Grade 7.
English and computer classes delivered to female Marastoon staff as assigned.
Lesson plans and teaching materials prepared and used.
Attendance and student-progress records maintained.
Regular assessments conducted and documented.
Teaching and activity reports submitted on time.

title: Information Management Officer (Education) (NO-2), FT, #00138039, Kabul - Afghanistan, APR (For nationals of Afghanistan only)
description:
The post holder is responsible for supporting the information management (IM) function to enable the effective functioning of the Cluster Working Group at the sub-national level, and the achievement of the core cluster functions, throughout the Humanitarian Programme Cycle (HPC) in order to facilitate a timely and effective Cluster Working Group response.The IM Officer contributes to effective coordination between sub-national and national Education Cluster coordination structures and supports information management processes related to humanitarian needs analysis, response monitoring, partner mapping, gap analysis and humanitarian reporting. The position also supports strengthened information sharing and operational alignment across humanitarian and Basic Human Needs coordination platforms within the evolving coordination architecture in Afghanistan.
UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.
At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.
UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.
Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.
For every child, the right to Education
How can you make a difference?
Humanitarian action is of fundamental importance to UNICEF and encompasses interventions aimed at saving lives, alleviating suffering, maintaining human dignity, and protecting the rights of affected populations wherever there are humanitarian needs, as well as interventions addressing underlying risks and causes of vulnerability to disasters, fragility and conflict. UNICEF’s humanitarian action is guided by the Core Commitments for Children in Humanitarian Action (CCCs) which set organizational, programmatic and operational commitments and benchmarks against which UNICEF holds itself accountable for the coverage, quality and equity of its humanitarian action and advocacy and which are mandatory for all UNICEF personnel.
Furthermore, UNICEF is committed to support humanitarian coordination through the cluster approach. Introduced as part of the humanitarian reform, the cluster approach aims at ensuring clear leadership, predictability and accountability in international responses to humanitarian emergencies by clarifying the division of labor among organizations and better defining their roles and responsibilities within the different sectors involved in the response. As a member of the IASC, UNICEF works along with national and local stakeholders (including national and local authorities, CSOs, and communities) to support humanitarian coordination and to improve the collective impact of humanitarian response. Whether the cluster approach is activated or not, UNICEF plays a key role in both global and country-level interagency coordination for its areas of programmatic responsibility. As Cluster Lead Agency (CLA) for Nutrition, WASH, Education (co-led), and Child Protection Area of Responsibility (AoR) within the Protection Cluster, UNICEF is committed to fulfil the core functions defined by the IASC when the clusters are activated or when UNICEF is asked to support sectoral coordination.
A well-run Cluster Working Group coordination team, including Information Management (IM), is a formal deliverable of the Cluster Lead Agency and forms a part of the agency’s work. The IM Officer (Education Cluster) is a core member of the Cluster Working Group coordination team.
Within the evolving humanitarian and Basic Human Needs coordination architecture in Afghanistan, the IM Officer supports information management processes that strengthen evidence-based decision-making, coordinated humanitarian response planning, inter-sectoral analysis and operational coordination between sub-national and national coordination structures.
Purpose of the Job: Under the overall direction and guidance of the Education Manager/Specialist Cluster Coordinator, the IM Officer (Education Cluster) manages and supports the information management function of the Education Cluster Working Group at sub-national level. The incumbent supports the collection, analysis, management and dissemination of information required to enable evidence-based humanitarian planning, response coordination, monitoring and reporting.
The postholder's main tasks and responsibilities will include but not be limited to:
Coordination and Representation
As a member of the coordination team, contribute to the effective roll out and monitoring of the core cluster functions (as outlined by the IASC Reference Module) and to the Humanitarian Programme Cycle (HNO, HRP and CCPM),
Support the Cluster Working Group IM function and coordinate with others within the function to ensure effective communication, reporting and engagement,
Actively engage with other IMs through relevant IMWGs, including participating in the Cluster Working Group IMWG and representing the Cluster Working Group on the inter-cluster IMWG as relevant at sub-national level,
Promote harmonized and coordinated approaches to IM across partners, AoRs/ Clusters Working Groups and OCHA at sub-national level.
IM Function Support
Implement an IM strategy and data collection and analysis plan at sub-national level that take into account the information needs of stakeholders and that are compliant with standards and protocols for ethical data and information management and that is aligned with the national level IM strategy and plan,
Implement regular secondary data reviews and primary data collection including designing questionnaires using appropriate tools,
Conduct data processing including organizing, cleaning, triangulating, evaluating and validating the data,
Analyze data to meet identified information needs of sub-national Cluster Working Group members and other stakeholders,
Create accurate, quality and timely information products that are in line with agreed style guides,
Disseminate information and information products through appropriate channels,
Maintain and ensure the accessibility of a common and shared secure storage system,
Gather feedback on IM products and use them to make improvements.
Needs Assessment and Analysis
Working collaboratively with other members of the Cluster Working Group at national and sub-national level, contribute to the planning and implementation of needs assessment and analysis, including joint assessments and analysis, as requested,
Collect information on economic needs, markets and price monitoring to support the equal consideration and use of all programme delivery modalities (in-kind, cash, voucher and services) as relevant at sub-national level,
Work with sub-national Cluster Working Group participants to identify information gaps, agree and implement ways to bridge those gaps by providing technical support to partners,
Analyze needs assessment data to provide required information for the HNO including estimating People in Need (PIN),
Contribute to joint and inter-sectoral analysis processes and support alignment of needs analysis findings across clusters/sectors and relevant humanitarian and Basic Human Needs coordination platforms at sub-national level.
Strategic Response Planning
Implement partner presence mapping at sub-national level,
Contribute to strategic planning, response prioritization and development of humanitarian response plans and related analytical products, including support to objectives, indicators, targets, partner mapping and response monitoring.
Resource Mobilization
Monitor and analyze the sub-national Cluster Working Group’s financial situation and support financial tracking,
Support and advocate with Cluster Working Group partners for financial reporting on the Financial Tracking Service (FTS),
Support evidence-based advocacy and resource mobilization by providing accurate, relevant and timely data, information and information products.
Implementation and Monitoring
Implement and maintain a sub-national Cluster Working Group monitoring plan and associated databases, including a response monitoring (3/4/5Ws) database that is in line with and contributes to national level databases,
Ensure the sub-national Cluster Working Group monitoring plan, and 3/4/5Ws include programme delivery modalities (in-kind, cash, voucher and services),
Support sub-national Cluster Working Group members to contribute timely and quality periodic monitoring reports on Cluster Working Group and OCHA platforms,
Support monitoring in the areas of information flows, dissemination, processing, analysis and dissemination,
Contribute to quantitative and qualitative gaps and coverage analysis to identify spatial and temporal gaps, overlaps and coverage of the sub-national Cluster Working Group humanitarian response,
Monitor adherence to relevant sector quality standards, regulations and codes at sub-national level.
Operational Peer Review and Evaluation
Participate in the annual cluster coordination performance monitoring (CCPM) exercise and annual review,
Contribute to sectoral and broader humanitarian evaluations.
Accountability to Affected People
Be accountable to affected populations by encouraging the meaningful participation of affected people, maintaining an effective feedback mechanism and handling complaints appropriately, by ensuring data about the most vulnerable is systematically collected and analysed, and by encouraging partners to work accountably,
Ensure the inclusion of cross cutting issues (age, child protection, disability, gender, gender, gender-based violence (GBV) mitigation and response and HIV & AIDS) in Cluster Working Group data collection, analysis and dissemination,
Adhere to child safeguarding and PSEA policies including procedures for challenging and reporting incidents.
Strengthen National and Local Capacity
Support or implement actions to strengthen local and national leadership and capacity by encouraging participation of local and national actors in the IM activities of the sub-national Cluster Working Group and providing support to partners to overcome technical and operational challenges in participating in IM activities,
Implement an IM capacity assessment and capacity development plan for sub-national Cluster Working Group partners.
The IM Officer (Education Cluster) position is based in Afghanistan and supports the Education Cluster coordination function at sub-national or regional level. The position reports to the Education Manager/Specialist Cluster Coordinator (P3/P4) and supports information management, data analysis, reporting and coordination processes required for effective Education Cluster coordination and humanitarian response planning.
If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: Information Management Officer, NO2, Job Description.pdf
To qualify an advocate for every child you will have…

Education: Bachelor or equivalent (First Level University Degree) in Information Management, Information Systems, Info. Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Science, information management, information systems, geographic information systems, information technology, computer science, statistics, social sciences, data science and any other related field is required.
Work Experience: 2 years of relevant work experience in Information Technology, Humanitarian Assistance, Education, Emergency, Monitoring and Evaluation, Response, information management, humanitarian coordination, education in emergencies, data analysis, needs assessment, monitoring and reporting, geospatial analysis, data visualization, response planning, cluster coordination and any other related field is a requirement.

Humanitarian coordination experience, cluster IM training, INEE minimum standards, Sphere standards, Core Humanitarian Standard experience will be an asset.
Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts will be considered an asset.

Role Summary
To manage, control, register, distribute, and archive all project documents related to the Solar PV Power Plant, Overhead Transmission Line, and High-Voltage Substation, ensuring compliance with company procedures, project requirements, and DABS PMO documentation standards.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
· Register and control incoming and outgoing letters, drawings, reports, and technical documents.
· Maintain document registers, drawing registers, revision histories, and submission tracking sheets.
· Manage document submissions, transmittals, comments, revisions, and approval records.
· Ensure that only the latest approved drawings and documents are distributed for construction.
· Coordinate document submissions and follow-ups with DABS PMO, consultants, the Project Manager, engineering teams, and site personnel.
· Prepare and track technical submittals, method statements, material approvals, inspection records, and project reports.
· Maintain organized electronic and hard-copy filing systems.
· Prepare regular document status reports and follow up on pending approvals and overdue responses.
· Maintain complete documentation for testing, commissioning, and final project handover.
3. Knowledge of DABS PMO
The candidate must have a good understanding of the role and working procedures of the Da Afghanistan Breshna Sherkat (DABS) Project Management Office (PMO) , particularly:
· Project correspondence, document submission, review, and approval procedures.
· DABS PMO requirements for engineering drawings, technical documents, progress reports, and project records.
· Document transmittals, revision control, technical comments, and approval tracking.
· Coordination and follow-up with DABS PMO representatives, consultants, and project management teams.

. Qualifications and Experience
· Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
· Minimum 2–3 years of document control experience, preferably in transmission line or HV substation projects.
· Previous experience with DABS projects and familiarity with DABS PMO procedures is strongly preferred.
· Good written and verbal English communication skills.

· Microsoft Word: Good — letters, reports, and document formatting.
· Microsoft Excel: Good — registers, tracking sheets, and status reports.
· Microsoft Outlook: Good — official email and document distribution.
· Adobe Acrobat / PDF tools: Good — reviewing, combining, and organizing PDF files.
· Microsoft Windows: Good — electronic filing, folder management, and backups.
· Microsoft PowerPoint: Basic — preparing presentations.
· AutoCAD: Basic — viewing drawings and checking titles, numbers, and revisions.
6. Performance Expectations
· Accurate and updated document registers.
· Timely submission and distribution of project documents.
· Proper tracking of DABS PMO comments, reviews, and approvals.
· Effective revision control to prevent the use of superseded drawings.
· Complete and traceable project documentation for final handover.

title: GIS Engineer (Re Announced)
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary :
A GIS engineer is responsible for building and maintaining GIS databases and utilizing the GIS software to analyze the spatial and non-spatial information in the databases, in other words, a GIS specialist refers to one who is professionally responsible for determining variables in a particular or given geographical area by implementing the Geographic Information System techniques and also supporting the engineering team in preparation of all types of GIS points and the area specification.
Responsibilities and Tasks:
· Develop and perform GIS analysis, modelling and reporting to support decision-making and determine the coverage areas in each project.
· Supporting the engineering team in preparation of all types of GIS maps, GIS points and area specifications.
· Carry out scanning and digitizing the mapping information to update and maintain map layers and compile the textual and graphic products of geographic data (vector, raster, aerial photograph, satellite imagery) as well as other sources of data.
· Executes all other tasks related to the Geographic Information System as required and provides GIS training for staff, where necessary.
· Provide input data to accomplish land cover and land use compilation or, when data are available through national sources, quality assurance/ quality control (QA/QC) analysis.
· Carry out geo-referencing, editing, Digitizing, and preparation of layout showing GPS points on the map with the use of ESRI software (Arc GIS 10.x)
· Convert GPS coordinates to geographic information and shape file in ArcGIS.
· Preparation of Water supply streams using analysis on the DEM map.
· Using the satellite image to find out and examine the area to make sure that project is physically implantable or either to cancel or reject the project implementation in the area.
· Follow and preparation of the database of cash-for-work projects in Faryab provinces.
· Find DEM (Digital Elevation Model) map and check the area according to DEM.
· Calculation of coverage area for Gabion check Dam and dry-stone check Dams.
· Preparation of my risk maps according to the information obtained from demining and PREVAL office.
· Analyzing the Water supply area based on DEM Map.
· Preparing a general map for each province that shows the status of the project. (in progress and completed)
Perform any other duties as required by the line manager.
Any other task assigned by line manager on time to time.

Job Requirements
Education & Training:
· Bachelor’s or master’s degree in GIS and remote sensing, engineering field, or equivalent
Training certificates in GIS software are strong assets for the role.
Experience:
· Minimum of 4 years of relevant professional experience, including applied experience in GIS Mapping & Design of water supply projects.
· Work experience with international / national organizations is required and a world bank project is preferable.
Ability to work well with a range of stakeholders, including project -affected peoples, government officials, international and Donors
Technical Skills:
· Proven skill in technical surveys and other data collection (maps, benchmark levels, etc.) for the design and preparation of drawings of water supply projects.
· Have the skill to ensure all technical inputs and cost estimates related to the construction components are accurate,
· Sound knowledge of finalizing the scope of work with the timeline needed for the implementation.
· Have experience in GIS map design of water supply projects etc.
· Proven skill in coordinating with the implementing partner NGO to get the desired outputs.
· Proven skill in coordinating with the relevant institutions and the communities.
· Having the skill to contribute towards the preparation of various reports on the status of implementation/progress with irrigation works.
· Good knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Office package, Internet, etc.
· A competent team player.
· Demonstrate strong oral and written communication skills and apply them in the working environment.
· Must have worked in hardship areas.
· Experience with the word bank project will be an added advantage.
· Proficient in the use of standard office applications (e.g., Microsoft Office) and other productivity engineering tools.

Submission Guideline
To apply for this vacancy, please visit the following link and fill out the application form:
https://actionaid.odoo.com/jobs/details/gis-engineer-111

description:
Role Summary
Sehat Andishan Ltd. is seeking a qualified, creative, responsible, and motivated professional to join our team in Kabul.
Position: IT & Graphic Design Officer
Duty Station: Kabul, Afghanistan
Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant professional experience
Gender: Both male and female candidates are eligible to apply; preference will be given to qualified female candidates.

Duties and Responsibilities
* Provide daily IT support and troubleshoot computers, software, printers, networks, internet, and email systems.
* Manage and update the company website, domain, hosting, and email accounts.
* Design professional brochures, catalogues, banners, posters, company profiles, and social media content.
* Perform graphic design, video editing, photo editing, and digital content creation.
* Prepare, edit, format, and design PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents.
* Maintain and organize company digital files, backups, and IT equipment records.
* Support staff with Microsoft Office and other IT-related requirements.
* Prepare and handle professional emails and business correspondence when required.
* Coordinate with IT, hosting, and other technical service providers.
* Perform other IT, graphic design, website, and digital-related duties assigned by management.

Job Requirements
Language Requirements – Mandatory
Candidates must have strong proficiency in the following languages:
* Dari/Persian: Full proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
* Pashto: Full proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
* English: Full proficiency is mandatory. The candidate must have excellent command of reading, writing, and speaking English and be able to communicate professionally, prepare written documents, conduct business correspondence, and write and respond to professional emails in English.
Candidates without sufficient English proficiency may not be considered for the position.
IT & Technical Skills
* Strong knowledge of computer systems and general IT troubleshooting.
* Ability to install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows, software applications, printers, scanners, and related IT equipment.
* Knowledge of computer networking, internet systems, email configuration, domains, and web hosting.
* Knowledge and practical skills in website design, website administration, and content updating.
* Strong command of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with file management, data backup, cloud storage, and basic information security practices.
* Ability to provide day-to-day IT and technical support to company staff.
Graphic Design & Digital Media Skills
* Strong practical skills in Graphic Design.
* Proficiency in graphic design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, or equivalent professional applications.
* Good skills in Video Editing using Adobe Premiere Pro or similar software.
* Ability to professionally design brochures, catalogues, posters, banners, business cards, company profiles, advertisements, and other promotional materials.
* Strong skills in document editing, formatting, and professional document design.
* Ability to edit, organize, design, and prepare professional PDF documents.
* Ability to create professional PowerPoint presentations.
* Ability to prepare and edit visual and digital content for the company’s website and social media platforms.
Administrative & Professional Skills
* Familiarity with general administrative procedures, office systems, and document management.
* Ability to organize, maintain, and archive company documents and digital files.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as effectively within a team.
* Must be responsible, organized, creative, proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to learn.
* Good problem-solving and time-management skills.

Submission Guidelines
Interested and qualified candidates are requested to submit their updated CV/Resume together with a portfolio or samples of previous work, particularly in Graphic Design, Video Editing, Website Design, Document Design, or other relevant areas.

title: Database and Application Support Associate-ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
1. Support the configuration, maintenance and routine enhancement of ACDMS applications and databases. Assist with updates to forms, fields, validation rules, reports and other system components in accordance with approved specifications and established procedures.
2. Support data import, migration, validation and quality-control activities. Conduct routine checks for completeness, consistency and accuracy of data, document findings and escalate unresolved issues as required.
3. Conduct assigned system testing activities, including functional, integration and user acceptance testing, in accordance with approved test cases and procedures. Assist with routine application and database maintenance, performance monitoring and implementation of approved system updates.
4. Provide first-line support to ACDMS users by responding to routine inquiries, assisting with user onboarding and training activities, and escalating complex or non-routine technical issues through established channels.
5. Assist in maintaining dashboards, reports, extracts and data-refresh processes. Verify outputs against approved definitions and report discrepancies or system issues.
6. Maintain technical documentation, user guides, issue logs, test records and configuration inventories. Follow approved version-control and change-management procedures.
7. Support user account administration and access management processes. Follow IOM data protection, information security, confidentiality and records-management requirements and report any suspected incidents or risks through established channels.
8. Work closely with the Senior Database and Developer Associate – ACDMS, National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, Database and Information Management Officer, ICT colleagues and programme focal points to carry out assigned support tasks and contribute to the effective day-to-day operation of ACDMS.
9. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Development, Database Administration or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience;
Or
High School diploma with five years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Experience providing application, database, data-management or information-technology support;
Experience using relational databases and SQL for routine queries, validation, reporting or data maintenance;
Experience supporting web-based applications or undertaking basic development, scripting or configuration tasks;
Experience conducting software testing, documenting defects and verifying corrections;
Experience cleaning, mapping, importing, validating or reconciling data;
Experience providing user support, recording incidents and escalating complex technical issues;
Experience maintaining technical documentation, user guidance, issue logs or configuration records;
Experience with version-control, ticketing or change-management tools is an advantage; and,
Experience with reporting, dashboards or business-intelligence tools is an advantage.
SKILLS
Working knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL;
Basic knowledge of web applications, programming or scripting and the ability to work within established development frameworks;
Ability to perform structured data cleaning, validation, import and reconciliation tasks accurately;
Ability to execute test cases, reproduce problems and document clear technical findings;
Good troubleshooting and user-support skills, including appropriate escalation of complex or sensitive issues;
Familiarity with version control, issue tracking, reporting tools or application-support workflows is an advantage;
Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, access control and information-security principles;
Good organisational, documentation and communication skills; and,
Ability to follow technical instructions, manage assigned tasks and work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Languages
For all Applicants, fluency in English is required (oral and written).
Working knowledge of Pashto or Dari is required.
Fluency in all national language(s) are highly advantages.
Note: Qualified female candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

Job Requirements
Required Competencies
Values
Inclusion and respect for diversity: respect promotes individual and cultural differences; encourages diversity and inclusion wherever possible.
Integrity and transparency: maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
Professionalism: demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
Core Competencies – behavioural indicators level 1
Teamwork: develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
Delivering results: produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner; is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
Managing and sharing knowledge: continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
Accountability: takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own action and delegated work.

title: National Information Management and Database Officer-ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
Coordinate the programme-facing implementation and continuous improvement of ACDMS, in close coordination with the Head of Programmes and Programme Managers, by consolidating programme priorities, preparing implementation roadmaps and workplans in relation to information management portfolio.
Conduct structured requirements gathering with Programme Managers, programme teams and information management focal points; document and validate business processes, user roles, data flows, functional and reporting requirements, acceptance criteria and change requests; and translate agreed needs into clear functional specifications and prioritised product backlogs for the technical team.
Coordinate the implementation and maintenance of ACDMS data governance arrangements, including common data standards, metadata, data dictionaries, master and reference data, beneficiary identification and deduplication rules, data quality controls, access roles, retention requirements and auditability, in accordance with IOM data protection principles, information security requirements and applicable institutional policies.
Coordinate the configuration, testing, rollout and operational use of common and programme-specific ACDMS modules, including beneficiary and service records, project management, document management, referrals and case management, needs and assessments, monitoring and evaluation, audit and related reporting functions; facilitate appropriate data migration and interoperability with existing systems and approved external interfaces.
Establish and coordinate user acceptance testing, data validation and release-readiness processes; ensure that defects, security or privacy concerns and gaps against approved requirements are recorded, prioritised and addressed in coordination with relevant technical teams; and maintain traceable approvals from the relevant programme owners before deployment of substantive changes.
Work with Programme Managers, reporting, analysis, visualisation, GIS and database colleagues to coordinate the development and delivery of reliable, timely and appropriately disaggregated information products, dashboards and cross-programme insights, with documented definitions and access controls, for operational management, programme monitoring, donor reporting and senior management decision-making.
Coordinate the development and implementation of an ACDMS adoption and capacity-building plan; coordinate user onboarding, guidance materials, standard operating procedures, training and support mechanisms; monitor system use and user feedback; and promote consistent application of approved workflows and standards across programmes and field locations.
Supervise assigned ACDMS personnel in accordance with the approved structure; set objectives, allocate work, review outputs and support staff development; maintain programme-facing system documentation, decision logs, inventories and handover materials; and promote collaborative working arrangements across the technical team and programme focal points.
Under the technical supervision of the Database and Information Management Officer, coordinate programme input into system architecture, database standards, interoperability, user access management, data governance, information security requirements, quality assurance protocols and technical roadmaps. Facilitate the review of ACDMS enhancements, new modules and integrations against approved information management standards and institutional policies before deployment.
Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

Education
Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Information Systems, Statistics, Software Engineering or a related field from an accredited academic institution;
Or
Bachelor’s degree in the above fields with two years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Experience coordinating the implementation or enhancement of information management systems, databases, management information systems or enterprise data platforms in humanitarian, development, migration or public-sector contexts;
Experience gathering business requirements and translating operational needs into functional specifications, workflows and system improvement initiatives;
Experience working with programme managers, field teams and multidisciplinary technical teams to support system implementation, testing, rollout, user adoption and change management;
Experience applying data governance, data quality, access control, data protection and information security principles and standards;
Experience overseeing data management processes, systems integration, data migration and interoperability between information systems;
Experience with databases, reporting and business intelligence environments; knowledge of SQL, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), web-based systems or dashboard solutions is an advantage;
Experience coordinating teams, workplans and competing priorities in a multi-programme environment; and,
Experience supporting the development and quality assurance of dashboards, reports and information products for operational, donor and management reporting.
SKILLS
Strong programme coordination, stakeholder engagement and requirements analysis skills, with the ability to bridge programme and technical perspectives;
Ability to apply information management standards, data governance frameworks, standard operating procedures and quality assurance processes;
Sound understanding of information management systems, databases, data integration, reporting and business intelligence solutions;
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess risks, prioritise requirements and develop practical solutions;
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and facilitate collaboration across multiple units and stakeholders;
Ability to supervise and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage competing priorities and support the delivery of system implementation and improvement initiatives;
Knowledge of data protection, information security, confidentiality and responsible data management principles; and,

title: National Specialist – M&E (MERL - Quantitative Research)
category: MEAL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning), Monitoring & Reporting
description:
Role Summary
POSITION OBJECTIVE
The incumbent will contribute to guiding M&E and MERL in high-quality survey sampling, research instrument design, statistical analysis, and also delivering training in quantitative research methods. The Quantitative Research Specialist, together with the M&E coordinator, will coordinate data collection in a wide range of multi-disciplinary areas using a set of common standards and data management practices. This will then allow data to be reused by other projects in the future, as well as providing the data for a wider audience across the AKDN network. She/he will also support the R&D pillar of MERL in the design, implementation, data management, analysis, reporting, and dissemination of outcome-level studies, such as Quality-of-Life study.
The position for the job holder will be funded by more than one grant, and s/he should expect to work on more than one project or program at any one time. Additionally, the job holder may spend up to approximately 80% of her/his working time focusing on research and evaluation, but up to 20% on a second area (e.g., Monitoring and MIS). This is to ensure that the Unit and its staff are flexible and can adapt as funding and programs change; and it ensures that MERL staff have a broad and professional understanding of MERL, which will enable them to progress their career within AKF-A. Where individuals wish to specialize, this will also be supported. The position holder is also supposed to apply the 70:20:10 capacity building model in their work, where 70% of learning will be on-the-job learning, while 20% will be through planned capacity building opportunities within MERL, as well as 10% through specific training programs for the career development of individuals.

Duties and Responsibilities
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Technical Support
• To develop common standards and practices related to quantitative research data collection.
• Prepare questionnaires and data collection formats and tools and to conduct field studies in AKDN programming areas.
• To do quantitative research survey methodology, sample selection, data cleaning, and analysis of survey results using any of these apps: SPSS, R, Stata, CSpro, or Python.
• Prepare presentations, brochures, and other technical documents from the outcome of the research for publication purposes.
• Actively monitor and analyze secondary data and trends from internal and external sources, academic research, and reports to inform and improve development programming.
• Present and communicate research and analysis clearly and effectively across various organizations in any format required.
• To design data entry forms in CSPro, Kobo Toolbox, ONA, or MS Access for data collection and entry.
• Serve as a technical resource person for MERL teams working in the regions.
• Undertake monitoring visits and evaluations of quantitative research-nature development projects.
• Train MERL staff in specialized procedures and theoretical concepts and analyze and interpret the results of surveys.
• Explore and recommend alternative approaches to improve the quality of research findings.
• To write comprehensive reports on the findings of the research and evaluation projects in collaboration with M&E/R/&D teams.
• To verify that the information on databases remains available, safe, and secure.
To participate proactively in knowledge uptake/community of practice and other learning platforms across AKDN networks.
 Planning
• Design relevant quantitative research methods for various studies and assessments under different projects as needed.
• In coordination with others in M&E/R&D teams, prepare work plans (monthly, quarterly, and yearly) and implement capacity building interventions for MERL officers in the regions.
• Regularly review and reflect upon the field monitoring reports, case studies and success stories conducted at the regions, and work of the 3rd parties contracted out by AKF-A.
 Reporting and updates
• Contribute to the development and compilation of the integrated data management system (IDMS), including the regular updates of project documents, PMFs, LFAs, and others as assigned.
• Contribute to the design, implementation, update, and reporting of project M&E plans.
• Provide high-quality research and evaluation reports in a timely manner.
 Representation
• Represent MERL in all M&E/R&D works across the AKDN network with professionalism and in partnership with other colleagues.
• Represent MERL at meetings, events/campaigns, and other national conferences and workshops.
• To carry out responsibilities of the role in a way which reflects AKF’s commitment to protecting children and vulnerable adults in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and Child Safeguarding Policy.
• To report any suspicions or actual violations of the Safeguarding Policy and and/or Child Safeguarding Policy as per the given training.
OCCASIONAL SIGNIFICANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Any tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor or MERL senior management.
DECISION-MAKING & AUTHORITY
 Administration
• Coordination of M&E/R&D activities.
• OIC for MERL as assigned and needed.
 Technical
• Planning and execution of M&E/R&D fieldwork in the regions.
• Participation in post data gathering exercises including reporting, presenting and knowledge uptake.
• Use of a solutions-focused approach to work.
 Geographical Scope
• NPO and regions.
 Other
• Ability to make decisions independently and on behalf of M&E/R&D teams when asked.

Job Requirements
JOB SPECIFICATION
• Bachelor's degree in international development, sociology, research, or any related field while a master's degree will be preferred.
• At least 5 years of work experience in survey design and implementation, research and evaluation.
• Ability to communicate clearly with partners, understand needs and challenges where appropriate
• To be able to travel and work in hard and remote areas.
• Working knowledge in at least one of the below data management and data analysis software is mandatory. (SPSS, R, Python, Stata, CSPro, SAS).
• Ability to draw informed and balanced conclusions and share results proactively.
REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES
• Attention to detail & quality control, High level of interpersonal skills.
• Communication skills e.g. oral and written communication skills in Dari/Pashto and English.
• Creativity, Innovation, tactful.
• Result Orientation, Accurate listening, working in remote areas, good team player.
• Accountability, Honesty, Sense of timing.
• Self-confidence and ability to work independently.

Submission Guidelines
APPLICATION
Interested applicants should submit their CV along with a cover letter to Jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org no later than 31st October 2026.
Important Notes:
• Please quote the Vacancy Number as the Subject of the e-mail when applying.
• No supporting documents (e.g., diplomas, recommendation letters, identification card(s), etc.) are required at this stage.
• Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for further assessment.
• Salary scale: Grade C, step 1 – 3 based on the organization’s salary scale.
The Aga Khan Foundation Afghanistan (AKF-Afg) promotes a transparent and equitable recruitment process. We reiterate that all services related to job applications, including processing, seminars, and training programs, are provided free of charge.
Our official job announcements are posted on the ACBAR website (acbar.org/jobs). Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their applications through our designated email address: jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org . Each job vacancy is assigned a unique identification number for your reference, and upon submitting your application, you will receive an automatic confirmation acknowledging its receipt immediately.

title: National Specialist – M&E (MERL - Quantitative Research)
description:
Job Summary
POSITION OBJECTIVE
The incumbent will contribute to guiding M&E and MERL in high-quality survey sampling, research instrument design, statistical analysis, and also delivering training in quantitative research methods. The Quantitative Research Specialist, together with the M&E coordinator, will coordinate data collection in a wide range of multi-disciplinary areas using a set of common standards and data management practices. This will then allow data to be reused by other projects in the future, as well as providing the data for a wider audience across the AKDN network. She/he will also support the R&D pillar of MERL in the design, implementation, data management, analysis, reporting, and dissemination of outcome-level studies, such as Quality-of-Life study.
The position for the job holder will be funded by more than one grant, and s/he should expect to work on more than one project or program at any one time. Additionally, the job holder may spend up to approximately 80% of her/his working time focusing on research and evaluation, but up to 20% on a second area (e.g., Monitoring and MIS). This is to ensure that the Unit and its staff are flexible and can adapt as funding and programs change; and it ensures that MERL staff have a broad and professional understanding of MERL, which will enable them to progress their career within AKF-A. Where individuals wish to specialize, this will also be supported. The position holder is also supposed to apply the 70:20:10 capacity building model in their work, where 70% of learning will be on-the-job learning, while 20% will be through planned capacity building opportunities within MERL, as well as 10% through specific training programs for the career development of individuals.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Technical Support
• To develop common standards and practices related to quantitative research data collection.
• Prepare questionnaires and data collection formats and tools and to conduct field studies in AKDN programming areas.
• To do quantitative research survey methodology, sample selection, data cleaning, and analysis of survey results using any of these apps: SPSS, R, Stata, CSpro, or Python.
• Prepare presentations, brochures, and other technical documents from the outcome of the research for publication purposes.
• Actively monitor and analyze secondary data and trends from internal and external sources, academic research, and reports to inform and improve development programming.
• Present and communicate research and analysis clearly and effectively across various organizations in any format required.
• To design data entry forms in CSPro, Kobo Toolbox, ONA, or MS Access for data collection and entry.
• Serve as a technical resource person for MERL teams working in the regions.
• Undertake monitoring visits and evaluations of quantitative research-nature development projects.
• Train MERL staff in specialized procedures and theoretical concepts and analyze and interpret the results of surveys.
• Explore and recommend alternative approaches to improve the quality of research findings.
• To write comprehensive reports on the findings of the research and evaluation projects in collaboration with M&E/R/&D teams.
• To verify that the information on databases remains available, safe, and secure.
To participate proactively in knowledge uptake/community of practice and other learning platforms across AKDN networks.
 Planning
• Design relevant quantitative research methods for various studies and assessments under different projects as needed.
• In coordination with others in M&E/R&D teams, prepare work plans (monthly, quarterly, and yearly) and implement capacity building interventions for MERL officers at the regions.
• Regularly review and reflect upon the field monitoring reports, case studies and success stories conducted at the regions, and work of the 3rd parties contracted out by AKF-A.
 Reporting and updates
• Contribute to the development and compilation of the integrated data management system (IDMS), including the regular updates of project documents, PMFs, LFAs, and others as assigned.
• Contribute to the design, implementation, update, and reporting of project M&E plans.
• Provide high-quality research and evaluation reports in a timely manner.
 Representation
• Represent MERL in all M&E/R&D works across the AKDN network with professionalism and in partnership with other colleagues.
• Represent MERL at meetings, events/campaigns, and other national conferences and workshops.
• To carry out responsibilities of the role in a way which reflects AKF’s commitment to protecting children and vulnerable adults in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and Child Safeguarding Policy.
• To report any suspicions or actual violations of the Safeguarding Policy and and/or Child Safeguarding Policy as per the given training.
OCCASIONAL SIGNIFICANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Any tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor or MERL senior management.
DECISION-MAKING & AUTHORITY
 Administration
• Coordination of M&E/R&D activities.
• OIC for MERL as assigned and needed.
 Technical
• Planning and execution of M&E/R&D fieldwork in the regions.
• Participation in post data gathering exercises including reporting, presenting and knowledge uptake.
• Use of a solutions-focused approach to work.
 Geographical Scope
• NPO and regions.
 Other
• Ability to make decisions independently and on behalf of M&E/R&D teams when asked.

Job Requirements
JOB SPECIFICATION
• Bachelor's degree in international development, sociology, research, or any related field while a master's degree will be preferred.
• At least 5 years of work experience in survey design and implementation, research and evaluation.
• Ability to communicate clearly with partners, understand needs and challenges where appropriate
• To be able to travel and work in hard and remote areas.
• Working knowledge in at least one of the below data management and data analysis software is mandatory. (SPSS, R, Python, Stata, CSPro, SAS).
• Ability to draw informed and balanced conclusions and share results proactively.
REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES
• Attention to detail & quality control, High level of interpersonal skills.
• Communication skills e.g. oral and written communication skills in Dari/Pashto and English
• Creativity, Innovation, tactful.
• Result Orientation, Accurate listening, working in remote areas, good team player

title: Senior Database and Software Developer Associate- ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
1. Develop, configure, maintain and support in the design of relational database structures, schemas, tables, views, functions, procedures and data models required for ACDMS modules. Apply approved naming conventions, data dictionaries, metadata and reference-data standards, and maintain technical consistency across development, testing and production environments.
2. Lead the configuration, maintainance and enhancement of secure web-based ACDMS applications and modules in accordance with approved functional and technical specifications to produce clean, documented and maintainable code, resolve defects, implement approved changes and steer controlled application upgrades and releases.
3. Develop and maintain approved application programming interfaces, data exchange services and integration routines connecting ACDMS modules with authorised internal or external systems. Conduct secure data migration, import, export, synchronisation and transformation processes with validation and reconciliation of migrated data.
4. Administer application source code, database scripts and related technical assets in approved version-control repositories applying agreed branching, peer-review, change-control, build and deployment practices, and maintain traceability between releases, approved requirements, test results and technical documentation.
5. Analyse and optimise database queries, application components and reporting processes to improve performance, reliability and scalability. Undertake routine technical maintenance, identify emerging capacity or performance issues, and recommend technical improvements or implement approved corrective actions in coordination with the Database and Information Management Officer and ICT.
6. Implement and verify approved authentication, authorisation, role-based access, encryption, logging and audit-control requirements, apply secure coding and database practices, promptly document and escalate identified vulnerabilities or privacy risks, to uphold technical compliance with IOM information security and data protection requirements.
7. Prepare and conduct unit, integration, regression, performance and technical tests, document results and defects, support user acceptance testing led by the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, and verify approved acceptance criteria and release-readiness requirements before deployment.
8. Build and maintain approved automated reports, extracts, data services, dashboards and interfaces with business-intelligence or visualisation tools, document calculations, filters, data refresh routines and technical definitions, and align them with validated programme and information management requirements
9. Implement and test approved backup, restoration, disaster-recovery and business-continuity arrangements for ACDMS databases and applications, and maintain configuration records and technical recovery documentation in coordination with ICT and the Database and Information Management Officer.
10. Provide second-line technical support for ACDMS, diagnose and resolve application, database, integration and performance incidents, maintain clear incident and change records, and escalate issues requiring infrastructure, security, vendor or management action through the established channels.
11. Maintain and develop system architecture records, database diagrams, data models, API documentation, deployment instructions, configuration registers, release notes, code documentation and troubleshooting guides to facilitate structured knowledge transfer to other technical personnel and contribute to relevant technical training and user guidance.
12. Coordinate day-to-day technical work with the direct supervisor, the Database and Information Management Officer, ICT and assigned developers or assistants, provide technical guidance, code and database review, assign technical tasks, review outputs and support knowledge transfer and technical development of assigned personnel to foster aligned, quality-assured technical delivery and developed team capability.
13. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

Education

Or
High School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Progressively responsible experience in database design, software or web application development, systems integration and technical support;
Experience developing and maintaining web-based applications using one or more established server-side and client-side programming languages or frameworks;
Experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs, web services or other data-integration mechanisms;
Experience using version-control platforms and structured software development, testing, release and change-management practices;
Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, role-based access, logging and other application or database security controls;
Experience with data migration, data validation, performance tuning, troubleshooting and production support; and,
Experience developing automated reports, dashboards or data services for business-intelligence and visualisation platforms is an advantage.
SKILLS
Advanced working knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL; experience with PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or comparable platforms;
Proficiency in at least one relevant application-development stack, such as .NET, Java, PHP, Python or a comparable server-side framework, together with JavaScript or a comparable client-side technology;
Knowledge of API design, systems integration, data transformation and structured interchange formats;
Working knowledge of Git or a comparable version-control system and collaborative development workflows;
Ability to interpret approved business and functional requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions;
Knowledge of secure coding, database security, access control, audit logging, data protection and information-security principles;
Ability to diagnose complex technical problems, document findings and implement reliable solutions in a controlled environment;
Good technical writing, communication, planning and knowledge-transfer skills; and,
Ability to work collaboratively with programme, information management and ICT colleagues while maintaining clear technical accountability.
